entry.content:
Write posts as Markdown files in _posts/, named YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md.

The front matter above is the minimum that works. Optional extras al-folio understands: featured: true to pin it, giscus_comments: true for comments, toc: sidebar for a table of contents, related_posts: false to hide the footer list.
